record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: approval-constraints
    kind: spec-gap
    expected: R7 / design invariant that the active write-policy constraint names the allowed dashboard write set (and that set is exclusive), while phase constraints also keep existing backlog promote/dismiss writes
    observed: `dashboard-human-gate-writes` statement says the dashboard may write only for Needs-you clears (answer/reject-routing, sign, accept-risk) via CLI with displayed revision; `dashboard/backlog.py` still supersedes promote/dismiss with `--expected-revision @current`, outside that set (applies_to names only dismiss/Needs-you UX)
    severity: major
integration:
  interfaces: Contract optional fields `answer` / `signed_note` / `resolution_note` in `contract/project-design.json`; `NeedsYouItem.revision` from model; `dashboard/dismiss.py` approve/reject/sign/accept argv (displayed `--expected-revision`, never `@current`; reject=`create` finding); `dashboard/approval.py` evidence + confirm helpers; `dashboard/app.py` list-`d`→detail, detail `a`/`x`/`s`/`d`→`NeedsConfirmModal`→dismiss; README key table; approval pilots in `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` / model / contract self-consistency
  assumptions: Brief work-item/spec/design/diff only (ignored execution-report/check-run/assessment/assignment text); constraint records read from primary store (store commits not on phase branch); CLI `update`/`correct` merge payload patches; `correct` has no `--expected-revision` (pre-`get` guard as designed)
  invariants: No write without detail+confirm — held for Needs-you path; stale never silently `@current` — held for update/accept, sign/reject pre-get guard; Reject never answers continuity-question — held; exclusive human-gate write-set invariant — not held vs backlog writes (finding above)
  conflicts: New exclusive human-gate constraint wording vs preserved backlog promote/dismiss writes; phase “don’t change backlog” vs “writes only for this human-gate set”
record.subject: dashboard-approvals-review
